purpose: Runs the §125 cafeteria-plan nondiscrimination tests from supplied aggregate participant counts: an eligibility-ratio test and a contributions-and-benefits ratio test (§410(b)-style ratio-percentage analogy -- IRS has never finalized regs under §125(g)(3), DRAFT pending final rules), and the statutory key-employee 25% concentration limit (IRC §125(b)(2), fixed). Returns per-test pass/fail and the concentration ratio. Not a plan-qualification opinion -- verify-side employer-evidence assembly only. Zero network, zero PII.
